page.title: Project settings
page.subtitle: Configure server-owned automation for this project.

section.heading: Scheduled routines
section.timezoneNote: Daily times use the Arij server's local timezone, not the browser's timezone. The in-process scheduler must be running for routines to trigger.
section.timezoneNoteZoned: Daily times use the Arij server's local timezone ({timezone}), not the browser's timezone. The in-process scheduler must be running for routines to trigger.
section.availableKinds: Available kinds: {kinds}. Unavailable kinds are hidden until their scheduler integration ships.

autofix.label: Enable CI autofix
autofix.description: Off by default. When enabled, a newly failing PR head may queue one normal fix session after CI watch sends its notification.

empty.title: No routines configured
empty.description: Existing manual and automated paths are unchanged until you add and enable a routine.

editor.ciWatchTimeNote: CI watch uses its interval; this time is retained but not used.
editor.configHintNightRun: Supports includeBacklog, failurePolicy, circuitBreaker, costCapUsd and namedAgentId.
editor.configHintGithubIssueSync: intervalMinutes is a freshness TTL; the selected daily time remains the schedule.
editor.configHintRetention: maxDeletedChunks bounds one run; vacuum allows the one-off reclaim after the first prune. The window itself is the session_chunk_retention_days setting.
editor.configHintInterval: intervalMinutes sets the polling cadence and must be a positive integer.
editor.scheduledTomorrow: Saved after today's {time} slot — first run scheduled for tomorrow ({timezone}).

errors.configNotObject: Configuration must be a JSON object.
